faqs.question: Which ideal weight formula is most accurate?
faqs.answer: The Robinson (1983) formula is the most widely cited in modern literature. However, all four formulas are estimates for average-framed adults.

faqs.question: Why are the formulas different from BMI?
faqs.answer: BMI gives a range based purely on height, while these formulas give a single target weight based on clinical observations.
